title: Deployment
description: A signal deployment to a specific deployment target with activation status and key

type.description: Discriminator indicating this is a platform-based deployment

is_live.description: Whether signal is currently active on this deployment

activation_key.description: The key to use for targeting. Only present if is_live=true AND requester has access to this deployment.

estimated_activation_duration_minutes.description: Estimated time to activate if not live, or to complete activation if in progress

type.description: Discriminator indicating this is an agent URL-based deployment

is_live.description: Whether signal is currently active on this deployment

activation_key.description: The key to use for targeting. Only present if is_live=true AND requester has access to this deployment.

estimated_activation_duration_minutes.description: Estimated time to activate if not live, or to complete activation if in progress

delivery_status.description: Arrival of provider-initiated membership delivery; separate from is_live (addressability) and match_status.

delivery.description: What the signal agent shipped, as a core/audience-source.json reference: the destination-side join key. No access_expires_at. Omitted when the rail has no vendor-addressable artifact. Never a credential.

delivery_error.description: Why delivery failed; present when delivery_status is failed. UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE when no declared rail intersects or the pin does not match.

match_status.description: Match outcome in the audience-status vocabulary sync_audiences reports; optional and rail-independent. too_small implies is_live false.

matched_count.description: Members matched; absence is not zero.

effective_match_rate.description: Deduplicated match rate; absence is not zero.

match_rate_basis.description: Where effective_match_rate came from, as on sync_audiences.

audience_size.description: People matched, as a range with stated precision (the #8024 shape), for platforms that report an interval. May replace matched_count. Omit when match_status is too_small.
